title: The Cold Gravity
author: Jude Lockridge
blurb: Marguerite Okonkwo, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
